assertion.statement: At the unknown base h0=1, if Lprime(E/K,1)=0 then the same primitive and corrected determinant coordinates are regular at(t) and have central value0.
assertion.objects: The actual retained finite free primitive complex, cycle z, paired integral functional lambda_z and its retained determinant basis over A=Lambda_(t), with residue fieldQ2.
assertion.hypotheses: The fixed companion has L(E^(k),1) nonzero; full two-primary Selmer corank overK is1. The conductor-one height formula and retained Kummer boundary apply to the actual point; the paired functional is integral overA and the corrected coordinate differs by a Lambda unit.
assertion.quantifiers: The single unknown base h0=1 in the final fixed-K family, under the hypothetical derivative vanishing.
assertion.parameter_range: Lambda=Z2[[t]] localized at(t); generic fraction fieldF and central residue fieldQ2.
assertion.uniformity: No numerical lower bound or companion-uniform estimate is used to prove this base vanishing.
assertion.constants: No new constants; central cohomology dimensions(1,1) in degrees1,2 and0 elsewhere.
assertion.normalizations: Use the same z, its own paired functional and retained determinant basis; tilde_u0=epsilon0*u_prim0 with epsilon0 a Lambda unit.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No finite Sha at the unknown base. If the generic complex is acyclic the coordinate is0 by definition; otherwise generic and central dimensions agree and no positive-power Smith disk occurs.
assertion.limit_order: Derivative vanishing makes the specified point torsion, then its rational Kummer class and specialized cycle vanish. Smith reduction gives the acyclic or no-jump alternative. Integral determinant base change proves central coordinate0; unit correction preserves it.
